subject: E-1359: totals mismatch on macOS
body:
Hi, I'm using SyncVault 4.2.3 on macOS 15.3. Since yesterday, every time I export the report, I get
'E-1359: totals do not match source'.

The summary still reflects last month's figures instead of this month's. If I open the underlying
records the values are correct.

What I tried so far: restarting the machine. No luck.

Daniel Ortega -- Caldera Foods. Appreciate any pointers.
